decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Jeskai Ascendancy to enable powerful combo plays, utilizing cards like Faeburrow Elder and Sylvan Caryatid to generate mana, while casting spells like Treasure Cruise and Expressive Iteration to draw cards and find key pieces. The deck also includes Tamiyo, Collector of Tales to help find essential combo pieces and protect against disruption. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the combo elements and ensure consistency in executing the game plan.

The deck focuses on using Fires of Invention to cast powerful spells for free while controlling the opponent's board with removal spells. The deck also utilizes the Transmogrify combo with Agent of Treachery to steal the opponent's creatures, as well as Yorion as a companion for extra value. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal, while generating card advantage with Narset and Omen of the Sea. Ultimately, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence and control the game until victory.

The deck aims to consistently ramp into Lotus Field using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Sylvan Scrying, enabling explosive combo plays with cards such as Hidden Strings and Pore Over the Pages to generate huge amounts of mana. Fae of Wishes offers versatile options for both combo pieces and disruption, while Emergent Ultimatum and Peer into the Abyss provide powerful finishers. The deck also includes support cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Bala Ged Recovery to ensure consistency and resilience. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with overwhelming card advantage and mana advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing Jeskai Ascendancy to generate massive amounts of mana by comboing with cheap cantrips and mana dorks. It aims to ramp quickly into its win conditions like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Sylvan Awakening, overwhelming the opponent with a powerful board presence and card advantage. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana flexibility. The deck aims to efficiently cycle through its library, manipulate its hand effectively, and assemble its combo pieces to establish a dominant board state and win the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with instants and sorceries, allowing you to bring back Arclight Phoenix from your graveyard. By utilizing cards like Thing in the Ice and Chart a Course to both dig through your deck and fuel your graveyard, you aim to overwhelm your opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass and Treasure Cruise helps you maintain card advantage while continuing to bring back Arclight Phoenix for additional pressure. The deck's mana base is designed to consistently provide the necessary colors for casting your spells efficiently.

The deck focuses on using Lotus Field alongside cards like Arboreal Grazer and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It then aims to use this mana to cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Peer into the Abyss to win the game in a single turn. The deck also includes cards like Hidden Strings and Pore Over the Pages to help dig for key combo pieces. Overall, the goal is to assemble the necessary pieces to create a game-winning combo as efficiently as possible.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Champion of Dusk, Knight of the Ebon Legion, and Gifted Aetherborn to aggressively pressure the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Thoughtseize to control the game and ensure a swift victory. With a mix of lifelink, card advantage, and removal spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of Mutavault and Voldaren Estate provides additional threats and synergy with the creature base.

The core idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive red creatures that can deal damage quickly. By utilizing powerful creatures like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Bonecrusher Giant, along with efficient burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on and finish the game before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Cemetery Gatekeeper and Eidolon of the Great Revel helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan and further increase the deck's aggression.

The main idea of the deck is to efficiently utilize Lotus Field as a mana source to generate explosive turns. By ramping quickly with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Vizier of Tumbling Sands, the deck aims to set up powerful combos using Hidden Strings and Shimmer of Possibility to dig for key pieces like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. By utilizing cards like Fae of Wishes and Mastermind's Acquisition, the deck is able to fetch important pieces from the sideboard to further enhance its game plan and overwhelm opponents with powerful plays.

This Selesnya aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with a combination of efficient early creatures like Youthful Valkyrie and Skyclave Apparition, and powerful late-game threats like Resplendent Angel and Righteous Valkyrie. The strategy is to swarm the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, while also gaining life through various means like Bishop of Wings and The Book of Exalted Deeds. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of beatdown pressure and resilient threats.

The focus of this deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures and burn spells to deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. It utilizes efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Rampaging Ferocidon along with powerful burn spells like Lava Coil and Play with Fire to control the board and keep pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Chandra, Torch of Defiance and other powerful cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Torbran, Thane of Red Fell further enhances the deck's ability to close out games quickly.

This deck focuses on using Jeskai Ascendancy to create a powerful combo with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Sylvan Caryatid to generate mana and draw cards. The goal is to quickly ramp up and chain spells together to win the game through a big explosive turn. The key strategy is to efficiently use the cards in hand to set up the board and create a win condition that overwhelms the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Lotus Field combo by using cards like Sylvan Scrying and Arboreal Grazer to ramp into it. Once Lotus Field is on the battlefield, the deck aims to take advantage of its unique mana generation ability to cast powerful cards like Omniscience, Emergent Ultimatum, and Peer into the Abyss to win the game in a single turn. The deck also utilizes cards like Hidden Strings and Fae of Wishes to manipulate the battlefield and find key pieces of the combo.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and flip Thing in the Ice. The deck utilizes cards like Chart a Course, Pieces of the Puzzle, and Expressive Iteration to dig for the combo pieces, while also using spells like Lightning Axe and Thundering Rebuke for removal. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick, aggressive strategy that can also generate card advantage and multiple threats. Additionally, Hall of Storm Giants can provide a powerful finisher if the game goes long.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. It aims to have a strong early game presence with cards like Soul-Scar Mage and Goblin Chainwhirler, while also having late-game reach with Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Torbran, Thane of Red Fell. The deck also utilizes lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins to continue applying pressure even after running out of gas in hand.

The main concept of this Jund Aggro deck is to set up a powerful synergy between sacrificing creatures and artifacts to generate value and deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Witch's Oven, Trail of Crumbs, Cauldron Familiar, and Mayhem Devil, the deck aims to control the board while also dealing incremental damage to the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Binding the Old Gods to further control the game, while using cards like Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt the opponent's game plan.
